description: Open the app for the first time
expected: The onboarding carousel is displayed with a "Get started" button

description: Register without filling First name and Last name
expected:
"First name is required" message appears
"Last name is required" message appears

description: Register with a password and confirm password that do not match
expected: "Passwords do not match" message is displayed
Logged in and the Home screen is displayed

description: Login with a valid email but an incorrect password
Request a reset code for a registered email
expected: Receive the confirmation code email and the code entry screen is displayed

description: Home screen for a logged-in user
expected:
1. Greeting with the user's first name
2. Upcoming bookings section
3. News section with a "View all" button

description: Log out from the Profile tab
expected: The login screen is displayed and the session is cleared
